content.text: John Smith reveals that he is actually millionaire Stanley G. Fulton, who secretly studied his three Hillerton cousins before deciding how to distribute his fortune. Miss Maggie initially feels betrayed, but forgives him, and they become engaged. She also inherits $50,000 and travels to Chicago, where Fulton returns after an invented South American expedition. The cousins gradually learn that their money has taught them valuable lessons: Frank returns to his grocery store, Hattie’s family moves to Plainville, Flora uses her wealth to help exhausted working girls, and Mellicent plans to marry Donald. Fulton and Maggie intend to fund hospitals, playgrounds, improved milk, housing, stores, and other community projects. The remaining material shifts to unrelated excerpts about Jacko the mischievous monkey, musical instruments across civilizations, engineering machinery, food, mining, agriculture, and scientific inventions.
